value.rationale: The modular idempotent variety and induced multiplication are natural invariants of a class of nonassociative quandle algebras. The theorem identifies a number-theoretic resonance that completely classifies the geometry over arbitrary matching-characteristic fields, proves the sharp first higher-dimensional jump at 17 and describes a new natural Takasaki subquandle. This is an infinite-family classification rather than a routine computational parameter slice.
